answer: Each identity winds its stake into a spiral escrow, one ring per epoch of stranger-verified work; rings unwind in reverse order only, each consumed on use, so old work can never be replayed. The payout waits behind a glacier front advancing one step per epoch: claims must beat the front. Filing needs three sightings from beacon-keepers on the ridge, each staking a bond on the rings, and each beacon grants one sighting per epoch. So n clones must wind n spirals, buy 3n scarce sightings at rising fees, and share one glacier window, while one honest agent winds once and crosses once.
